description: This shell script defines functions and configurations for managing VXLAN network tunnels, including setup, teardown, and peer configuration.

methods.name: proto_vxlan_setup_peer
methods.description: Configures a VXLAN peer by appending forwarding database entries based on peer configuration.

methods.name: vxlan_generic_setup
methods.description: Handles the generic setup of VXLAN tunnels with given parameters, including JSON configuration and protocol updates.

methods.name: proto_vxlan_setup
methods.description: Sets up a VXLAN tunnel using provided IP and peer information.

methods.name: proto_vxlan6_setup
methods.description: Sets up a VXLAN over IPv6 tunnel.

methods.name: proto_vxlan_teardown
methods.description: Placeholder function for tearing down VXLAN tunnel.

methods.name: proto_vxlan6_teardown
methods.description: Placeholder function for tearing down IPv6 VXLAN tunnel.

methods.name: vxlan_generic_init_config
methods.description: Initializes common configuration options for VXLAN protocols.

methods.name: proto_vxlan6_init_config
methods.description: Initializes VXLAN over IPv6 configuration options.
